ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: KDS/HAR/4/2/1/54. Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation: 4-3/18/2019/WS/486. I hereby give notice under sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land as it is needed to acquire additional allotments of land for the Laying of Pipe Lines to Carry Untreated Water under Kundasale - Haragama Water Supply Project. Description of the land to be acquired: The allotments of land depicted as Lot Nos. 4, 5, 7, 11 in L.D.L. 4 and 5, in Sheet No. 5, in Block No. 02 in the Cadastral Map No. 320461, Surveyed and prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kandy District, situated at the Village of Polwatta, in No. 420, Polwatta Grama Niladhari Division, in Kulugammana Siyapattuwa Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Harispattuwa, in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Kotuwagawahinna; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Sri Maha Paththini Devalaya, Kandy, J. K. Saumyalatha Jayawardhana enjoys the land; Extent: 0.0031 Hectare. North: Lot Nos. 2, 1 and 3; East: Lot Nos. 3 and 10; South: Lot Nos. 9 and 5; West: Lot No. 5, Lot No. 23 in sheet 1 and Lot No. 2 in the said plan. 02. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: Kotuwagawahinna; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Sri Maha Paththini Devalaya, Kandy, J. K. Saumyalatha Jayawardhana enjoys the land; Extent: 0.0003 Hectare. North: Lot No. 4; East: Lot Nos. 4, 9, 10 and 8; South: Lot No. 7; West: Lot No. 23 in Sheet 1. 03. Lot No. 7 Name of the Land: Kotuwagawahinna; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Sri Maha Paththini Devalaya, Kandy, Indrani Fonseka enjoys the land; Extent: 0.0046 Hectare. North: Lot Nos. 5 and 9; East: Lot Nos. 10 and 8; South: Lot Nos. 12 and 11; West: Lot No. 23 in Sheet 1 and Lot No. 6 in the said plan.

04. Lot No. 11 Name of the Land: Kotuwagawahinna; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Sri Maha Paththini Devalaya, Kandy, Indrani Fonseka enjoys the land; Extent: 0.0017 Hectare. North: Lot Nos. 7 and 8; East: Lot No. 12; South: Lot No. 12 and Lot No. 139 in Sheet 1; West: Lot Nos. 139 and 23 in sheet 1. All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me on 09.06.2025 at 10.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat, Harispattuwa. And further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate before the 02.06.2025, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Mඈඁൺඇ Dඁൺඋආൺൽൺඌൺ, Divisional Secretary, Harispattuwa. At the Divisional Secretariat, Harispattuwa, On 24th day of March, 2025. EOG 03 - 0267
